entities.name: Murder of Ayşenur Halil and İkbal Uzuner
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Ayşenur Halil and İkbal Uzuner were murdered by Semih Çelik (19) within a half hour of each other on 4 October 2024 in Istanbul, Turkey. The public murder–suicide, during which Çelik threw İkbal Uzuner's severed head off the Walls of Constantinople in front of her mother before committing suicide by jumping, sparked protests about femicide in Turkey.
